subject: Invoice emit plan and delivery preference - portal opt-in vs email fallback
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: TheraNova AP <ap@theranova.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Jun 2024 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice emit plan and delivery preference - portal opt-in vs email fallback

Hi Marco / Theranova AP team,

Thanks for taking the call yesterday. Quick note to align on how Redwood should *emit* invoices once we go live next month. Two items we need your direction on so billing can be set up cleanly:

1) Portal enrollment window: we can enroll you in the Redwood Billing Portal (recommended for AP automation) but need a firm opt-in by 6/25 to have portal tokens and SSO tested before first invoice. If you opt in, we will stop sending invoice PDFs by email after the first month.

2) Email fallback: if portal enrollment is delayed, do you want invoices sent as PDF attachments to ap@theranova.com, or to a narrower AP contact + CC to your billing alias? We can also enable both (portal + email copy) temporarily.

Also: we support two invoice emission patterns — immediate per-invoice (near real-time) or a consolidated weekly batch. Please confirm preferred cadence for PO matching on your side.

Attached is a copy of the PO you shared (TheraNova_PO_8891.pdf) and a sample Redwood invoice layout for multi-entity customers.

Next steps I propose: you confirm portal opt-in (yes/no) and preferred delivery cadence by EOD 6/18, and we'll lock the emit schedule. If you prefer, Marissa can schedule a short walkthrough of the portal for your AP team.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: Theranova_PO_8891.pdf (application/pdf), redwood_invoice_sample_multi-entity.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Marco Silva <msilva@theranova.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Theranova AP <ap@theranova.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Jun 2024 13:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Invoice emit plan and delivery preference - portal opt-in vs email fallback

Karthik,

Thanks — appreciate the clarity. A couple of follow-ups from our AP team:

- VAT evidence: we operate in the EU for some transactions. If Redwood sends invoices by email we need VAT breakdown and a VAT ID field on the PDF (your sample looks good but confirm). If we use the portal, we'll rely on portal metadata for VAT reconciliation.

- Consolidation: we prefer a weekly consolidated invoice (Friday close) to minimize PO matching overhead. Can Redwood mark line items with our PO number and include a CSV export in the portal?

- Contact: please send invoices to ap@theranova.com and cc msilva@theranova.com for the first two bill cycles while we test portal onboarding. After successful portal SSO and automated pull, we will turn off email copies.

Can you also confirm the opt-in deadline you mentioned? 6/25 works, but we may need a quick portal demo for two AP users.

Best,
Marco Silva
CFO | TheraNova Inc
msilva@theranova.com

Thanks for the forward — we can support this flow. Confirmations and action items below: 

1) Emit cadence: weekly consolidated invoice (Friday close) starting 2024-07-05. We will aggregate invoices for the week and include a single PDF plus a CSV export (invoice_line_items.csv) with the header row: invoice_id, invoice_date, customer_po_number, sku, description, quantity, unit_price, line_vat_amount, line_total.

2) Email fallback: we will send the PDF to ap@theranova.com and cc msilva@theranova.com for two cycles (7/05 and 7/12). After 7/12, we will stop email copies if the portal SSO test passes.

3) VAT fields: the PDF template will include a VAT ID field in the header and line-level VAT breakdown. We will also include a reverse_charge flag in the CSV for any lines marked that way.

4) Samples: attached is a redwood_invoice_sample_multi-entity.pdf (header mock showing VAT ID) and a one-line sample CSV (invoice_line_items_sample.csv).

5) SSO checklist: we will provide a short checklist for Theranova's IT (exchange of SP metadata, test user, verification steps) — I'll draft and upload to the deal record.

I'll upload the sample files to the HubSpot deal and send a DocuSign packet for your billing contact to acknowledge the change in delivery preference (link included in related_links).

Kimberly Park
Billing Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
